message.content:
This editorial illustration features an illustrated man in a white collared shirt standing behind a counter, pouring a dark brown liquid from a clear pitcher into three white mugs held by hands reaching from the bottom foreground. The man has short black hair, closed eyes, and a neutral expression. In the background, two grey coffee grinders sit on the counter. On the wall behind the man, a framed portrait shows a person wearing a black songkok and suit. 

Large red letters spelling "TEMPO" are at the top, partially obscured by a bright white light flare that originates from the man’s chest area. To the left, black text reads "PANGGUNG POLITIK SJAFRIE" above a smaller paragraph of Indonesian text. Additional text at the top and bottom includes "Kuota Impor Tekstil," "Perdagangan Karbon," and publication details like "27 OKTOBER-2 NOVEMBER 2025" and "RP 60.000." A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner. The lighting creates a strong glow across the center of the image, fading into brown and grey tones.
